'''Jonathan Swenson''' (also published as '''Jon Swenson''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Bravo 13 from Moorhead, Minnesota.<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref> Jonathan Swenson also finished 3rd at [[1999 GenCon Open]] on 7 August 1999, according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d29">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 3 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
